tables.purpose: Daily power generation, export, import, consumption, operating hours; deduped latest per Date for BI.
Daily steam generation and consumption; StmCons3*35 mapped to StmCons3*70 in API; deduped latest per Date.
Equipment stoppage incidents; Duration computed client-side in hours; all rows in range (no dedupe).

rows.name: Operating Days
rows.description: Count of daily power logbook points in the selected From-To range (one per deduped date).
rows.formula: daily.length where daily = buildDailySeries(powerRows, steamRows); one point per ph_power.Date after dedupeLatestPerDate

rows.name: Range preset and compare label
rows.description: Subtitle under Operating Days showing active date preset and comparison chip name.

rows.name: MTD
rows.description: Month-to-date preset: From = first day of month containing To; To = latest data date or user To.
rows.formula: getCockpitPresetDateRange('MTD', ref, seasonMapping) => { from: formatYMD(new Date(y, m, 1)), to: formatYMD(now) }

rows.name: STD
rows.description: Season-to-date preset: From = season_mapping startDate for To-date season, else Oct 1 of season year.
rows.formula: getCockpitPresetDateRange('STD', ref, seasonMapping); from = seasonMapping[findSeasonLabelForDate(to)].startDate || Oct 1 fallback

rows.name: WTD
rows.description: Week-to-date preset: From = Monday of week containing To.

rows.name: Custom
rows.description: User-selected From and To date inputs, clamped to data min/max.

rows.name: Compare: Prev. Period / Prev. Season / Prev. Week / Prev. Month
rows.description: Prior-period comparison chip (id PP). Label varies by rangePreset via getCockpitPPLabel.
rows.formula: resolveCockpitCompareRange(..., "PP", ...) => resolveCockpitPriorRange; STD+mapping uses alignMappedSeasonByDayOffset to previous season day 1-N else computePriorPeriodRange

rows.name: Compare: season chips
rows.description: Each season_mapping row except current season; id SEASON:{label}. Compare window aligned by day offset (STD) or calendar month/day (MTD/WTD/Custom).
rows.formula: resolveCockpitCompareRange(..., seasonCompareOptionId(label), ...); STD: alignMappedSeasonByDayOffset; else: alignMappedSeasonCompareRange

rows.name: From
rows.description: Start date of dashboard range; drives API from= query param.

rows.name: To
rows.description: End date of dashboard range; drives API to= query param and season label lookup.

rows.name: Bagasse Produced
rows.description: Total bagasse recorded on the power logbook across the selected date range.
rows.formula: sum(powerRows, 'Baggase') — SUM of non-null numeric ph_power.Baggase; null/'' treated as 0
rows.comparison: pctDiff = ((value - compareValue) / compareValue) * 100; shown when compareValue is finite number and compareValue !== 0; label "vs {compareLabel}" where compareLabel from resolveCockpitCompareRange (PP: Prev. Month|Prev. Season|Prev. Week|Prev. Period by rangePreset; season chip: mapped season label). Higher is good (inverseGood=false).

rows.name: Cane Crushed
rows.description: Total cane crushed recorded on the power logbook across the selected date range.
rows.comparison: pctDiff = ((value - compareValue) / compareValue) * 100; shown when compareValue is finite number and compareValue !== 0; label "vs {compareLabel}" where compareLabel from resolveCockpitCompareRange (PP: Prev. Month|Prev. Season|Prev. Week|Prev. Period by rangePreset; season chip: mapped season label). Higher is good (inverseGood=false).

rows.name: Total Power Generation
rows.description: Sum of all turbine generator outputs in the range.

rows.name: Total Gen
rows.description: Daily total generation for the area chart.

rows.name: 30 MW generation (Mn)
rows.description: 30 MW generation expressed in millions of kWh.

rows.name: 30 MW PLF
rows.description: Plant load factor for 30 MW turbine.
rows.formula: PLF_30MW = safeDiv(sum(p,'PowerGen30') * 100, sum(p,'Hours30') * 30000); safeDiv returns null if denominator 0/null

rows.name: 30 MW
rows.description: Daily PLF trend for 30 MW.
rows.formula: buildDailySeries daily.PLF_30MW per date; YAxis domain [0,120]; clampPct on Export_pct/Int_Cons_pct only not PLF

rows.name: 3 MW Old generation (Mn)
rows.description: 3 MW Old generation expressed in millions of kWh.

rows.name: 3 MW Old
rows.description: Daily PLF trend for 3 MW Old.
rows.formula: buildDailySeries daily.PLF_3Old per date; YAxis domain [0,120]; clampPct on Export_pct/Int_Cons_pct only not PLF

rows.description: 3 MW New generation expressed in millions of kWh.

rows.name: 4 MW generation (Mn)
rows.description: 4 MW generation expressed in millions of kWh.

rows.name: 4 MW PLF
rows.description: Plant load factor for 4 MW turbine.

rows.name: Power to Grid
rows.description: Total power exported to the grid from the 30 MW export meter.

rows.name: Export % of generation
rows.description: Share of total generation exported to grid.
rows.formula: Export% = safeDiv(ExportGrid30, Total_Power_Gen); display formatPct multiplies ratio by 100 if |v|<=1.5

rows.name: Inhouse Consumption
rows.description: Total internal consumption: cogen export + sugar export + distillery/CPU load.
rows.source: ph_power.ExportCogen30, ph_power.ExportCogen3New, ph_power.ExportCogen3Old, ph_power.ExportCogen4, ph_power.ExportSug30, ph_power.ExportSug3New, ph_power.ExportSug3Old, ph_power.ExportSug4, ph_power.PowerGen4MW, ph_power.ExportDist30, ph_power.Imp_4MW

rows.name: Inhouse share % of generation
rows.description: Internal consumption as percent of total generation.
rows.formula: Int_Cons% = safeDiv(Total_Internal_Con, Total_Power_Gen); chart uses Int_Cons_pct = Int_Cons% * 100

rows.name: Export %
rows.description: Daily grid export as percent of that day total generation.

rows.name: Inhouse %
rows.description: Daily internal consumption as percent of that day total generation.

rows.name: Deduped daily power/steam rows
rows.description: Before KPI aggregation, only the latest timestamp row per Date is kept for ph_power and ph_steam.
rows.formula: dedupeLatestPerDate(rows): for each Date keep row with max(timestamp); ORDER BY Date ASC, timestamp ASC before dedupe

rows.name: Stoppage duration per row
rows.formula: durationHours(start_time, end_Time) = (new Date(end_Time) - new Date(start_time)) / 3600000; signed if end < start

rows.name: formatCompact display
rows.description: Most numeric UI values use formatCompact: null/non-finite => em dash; >=1e6 => X.XM; >=1e3 => X.XK; else en-IN locale.
